selection: First two lexicographically ordered repeated complete raw tuples in frozen locator result; all objects in each tuple; metadata only
required_evidence: Literal primary locus and depth, datum, stratigraphic context
Any explicit shared-deposition and distinct-physical-object evidence; record unavailable observations separately
stop: Four targets and their directly cited retained primary records. No target replacement, broad public search, sign-outcome review or significance test. No table-wide validation from this pilot.
unavailable: Missing primary coverage remains unresolved because primary evidence is unavailable, not negative identity evidence
interpretation: Pilot records do not themselves establish independent deposition or replicated contextual contrast
